project.name: AIRobot
project.description: A Java implementation of a Llama model inference engine with tensor operations, GGUF model loading, tokenization, and sampling. Supports quantized tensor formats (Q4_0, Q8_0, BF16, F16) and rotary position embeddings (RoPE).

nodes.name: FloatTensor.java
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for all tensor types in the LLM inference engine, providing core tensor operations (dot, matmul, softmax, RMSNorm helpers, reductions) with SIMD vector API acceleration

nodes.name: FloatTensor
nodes.summary: Abstract base class for float tensor types. Defines the tensor algebra interface: dot product, matrix multiply, reductions (sum/max/argmax), in-place operations (add/multiply/divide/fill/softmax/saxpy), and utility methods. Uses Java Vector API and sun.misc.Unsafe for memory access.

nodes.name: argmax
nodes.summary: Finds the index of the maximum value in a tensor slice. Used by Sampler.ARGMAX for greedy token selection.

nodes.name: ArrayFloatTensor.java
nodes.summary: Float tensor backed by a plain Java float array with full read/write support, used for KV cache and activation buffers

nodes.name: ArrayFloatTensor
nodes.summary: Float tensor backed by float[] array. Supports get/set/fill and SIMD getFloatVector. Used for KV cache and state buffers where random access writes are needed.

nodes.name: BF16FloatTensor.java
nodes.summary: BF16 (bfloat16) quantized tensor with vectorized dot product using SIMD short-to-float conversion

nodes.name: BF16FloatTensor
nodes.summary: BF16 quantized float tensor backed by MemorySegment. Implements vectorized dot product by loading shorts, converting bf16→float via left-shift and reinterpret, then FMA-accumulating. SetFloat and getFloatVector throw UnsupportedOperationException.

nodes.name: vectorDot
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated dot product for BF16 tensors. Loads short vectors, casts to int, left-shifts 16 bits, reinterprets as float, and FMA-accumulates against the other tensor's float vector.

nodes.name: F16FloatTensor.java
nodes.summary: FP16 quantized tensor with software float16-to-float32 conversion and SIMD vectorized dot product

nodes.name: F16FloatTensor
nodes.summary: FP16 quantized float tensor. Converts float16 bits stored as shorts to float32 using manual exponent/mantissa manipulation. Implements fast vectorized dot product with software float16 decode and FMA accumulation.

nodes.name: vectorDot
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated dot product for FP16 tensors. Manually decodes float16 bit-representation to float32 in vector registers, then FMA-accumulates. Handles denormals, infinities, and NaN per IEEE 754-2008.

nodes.name: Q4_0FloatTensor.java
nodes.summary: GGML Q4_0 4-bit quantized tensor with blockwise FP16 scale and SIMD vectorized dot product

nodes.name: Q4_0FloatTensor
nodes.summary: GGML Q4_0 block-quantized tensor (32 values per block, FP16 scale, 4-bit nibbles). Implements vectorized dot product by dequantizing nibbles to floats in SIMD registers and FMA-accumulating against the reference tensor.

nodes.name: getFloat
nodes.summary: Dequantizes a single element from Q4_0 block format: reads the FP16 scale via readShort+Float.float16ToFloat, then extracts the appropriate nibble from the block data.

nodes.name: vectorDot
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated dot product for Q4_0 tensors. Unpacks nibble-pairs into low/high byte vectors, casts to float, multiplies by scale, and FMA-accumulates. Supports multiple vector lane widths (128, 256, 512-bit).

nodes.name: Q8_0FloatTensor.java
nodes.summary: GGML Q8_0 8-bit quantized tensor with blockwise FP16 scale and SIMD vectorized dot product

nodes.name: Q8_0FloatTensor
nodes.summary: GGML Q8_0 block-quantized tensor (32 values per block, FP16 scale, 8-bit signed integers). Implements vectorized dot product by broadcasting scale and casting bytes to floats in SIMD registers.

nodes.name: vectorDot
nodes.summary: SIMD-accelerated dot product for Q8_0 tensors. Loads quantized bytes, casts to float, multiplies by FP16 scale, and FMA-accumulates against the reference float vector. Supports 128, 256, and 512-bit vector lanes.

nodes.name: GGMLType.java
nodes.summary: Enum of all supported GGML tensor types (F32, F16, BF16, Q4_0, Q8_0, k-quants, IQ quants) with type size and block size metadata

nodes.name: GGMLType
nodes.summary: Enum with 30+ GGML tensor format types. Each variant specifies typeSize and blockSize. Provides byteSizeFor() for memory sizing and fromId() for deserialization. Supports F32, F16, BF16, Q4_0, Q4_1, Q8_0, Q8_1, K-quants, and more.

nodes.name: GGMLTensorEntry.java
nodes.summary: Record holding a mapped tensor's metadata: MemorySegment, name, GGML type, shape dimensions, and data MemorySegment

nodes.name: CategoricalSampler.java
nodes.summary: Categorical (multinomial) sampler that draws a token from a probability distribution using cumulative distribution function inversion

nodes.name: Sampler.java
nodes.summary: Functional interface for token sampling strategies, providing ARGMAX greedy sampler as a built-in constant

nodes.name: AOT.java
nodes.summary: Ahead-of-time model preloading: pre-loads a GGUF model into memory so subsequent inference can skip file I/O

nodes.name: AOT
nodes.summary: AOT model preloader. Stores a pre-loaded PartialModel (GGUF + tensors) keyed by filename. tryUsePreLoaded() checks for a matching pre-loaded model and creates a Llama instance from it, skipping file I/O.

nodes.name: preLoadGGUF
nodes.summary: Validates model path, opens file channel, loads GGUF header and metadata, computes tensor data offsets, stores the pre-loaded model in a static map keyed by filename.

nodes.name: tryUsePreLoaded
nodes.summary: Checks if a matching pre-loaded model exists (same filename, sufficient context length). If found, maps tensor data from the file channel, loads weights, and creates a Llama instance from the pre-loaded model.

nodes.name: ChatFormat.java
nodes.summary: Chat message formatting following the Llama 3 chat template: encodes dialog turns with special tokens and message roles

nodes.name: ChatFormat
nodes.summary: Llama 3 chat template formatter. Encodes system/user/assistant dialog turns to token sequences using special tokens (<|begin_of_text|>, <|start_header_id|>, <|end_header_id|>, <|eot_id|>, etc.). Provides encodeMessage() and encodeDialogPrompt() for conversation formatting.

nodes.name: ChatFormat
nodes.summary: Constructs ChatFormat by fetching special tokens from the tokenizer and mapping them to named fields (beginOfText, endHeader, endOfTurn, endOfMessage, etc.).

nodes.name: encodeDialogPrompt
nodes.summary: Encodes a full dialog into a token sequence. Optionally appends the assistant header to prompt for a response.

nodes.name: GGUF.java
nodes.summary: GGUF model file format reader: parses headers, metadata key-value pairs, tensor info, and memory-maps tensor data

nodes.name: GGUF
nodes.summary: GGUF format parser. Loads model files by reading magic bytes, version, tensor count, alignment, and key-value metadata. Provides readHeader(), readArray(), readTensorInfo(), and typed read methods (readInt, readFloat, readString, etc.). loadTensors() memory-maps tensor data and creates GGMLTensorEntry records.

nodes.name: loadModelImpl
nodes.summary: Internal model loading: reads header, iterates tensor info entries, computes alignment padding, and sets the tensor data offset.

nodes.name: loadTensors
nodes.summary: Memory-maps the tensor data region, iterates tensor info entries, computes size and offset, creates GGMLTensorEntry records for each tensor.

nodes.name: readTensorInfo
nodes.summary: Reads a single GGUF tensor info entry: name string, number of dimensions, dimension values, GGML type, and data offset.

nodes.name: readKeyValuePair
nodes.summary: Reads a metadata key-value pair: validates the key string, reads the value, returns a Pair of key and typed metadata value.

nodes.name: readHeader
nodes.summary: Reads GGUF file header: validates magic bytes (GGUF), reads version (must be supported), tensor count, alignment, then reads all metadata key-value pairs into a HashMap.

nodes.name: readArray
nodes.summary: Reads a GGUF metadata array: reads the element type and count, then dispatches to typed read methods for each element. Supports byte, short, int, float, bool, string, and nested arrays.

nodes.name: readMetadataValueOfType
nodes.summary: Dispatches to the correct typed read method based on a MetadataValueType enum value (byte, short, int, float, long, double, bool, string, array).

nodes.name: Llama.java
nodes.summary: Core Llama model record holding configuration, tokenizer, and weights; provides inference forward pass and token generation loop

nodes.name: Configuration
nodes.summary: Llama model hyperparameters: dim, hiddenDim, numberOfLayers, heads, vocabularySize, contextLength, RMS norm epsilon, RoPE theta, headSize. Provides withContextLength() for creating variants with overridden context length.

nodes.name: Weights
nodes.summary: All model weights: token embedding table, RMS norm weights per layer, attention projection matrices (wq/wk/wv/wo), FFN matrices (w1/w2/w3), final RMS norm weight, RoPE frequency buffers, and optional classifier head (wcls).

nodes.name: State
nodes.summary: Inference state holding activation buffers (x, xb, hb, q, k, v, att, logits) and KV cache (keyCache, valueCache) for batched decoding. All tensors are ArrayFloatTensor instances.

nodes.name: forward
nodes.summary: Core transformer forward pass: token embedding lookup, multi-head attention with RoPE, KV cache, SwiGLU FFN, residual connections, and final RMS norm + classifier. Supports batched inference across multiple tokens.

nodes.name: generateTokens
nodes.summary: Token generation loop: ingests prompt tokens in batches, runs forward pass, samples next token via Sampler, stops on stop tokens or max tokens. Reports prompt/generation throughput stats.

nodes.name: Llama3.java
nodes.summary: Llama 3 CLI application with interactive chat mode and single-shot instruct mode, plus subgraph4j image processing integration

nodes.name: Llama3
nodes.summary: Main CLI / subgraph4j node for Llama 3. Provides runInteractive() for multi-turn chat, runInstructOnce() for single prompt, selectSampler() for temperature/top-p, and Options class for CLI argument parsing.

nodes.name: selectSampler
nodes.summary: Selects a sampler strategy based on temperature and top-p: temperature=0 uses ARGMAX (greedy), top-p=1 uses CategoricalSampler, otherwise creates ToppSampler with temperature scaling and softmax.

nodes.name: runInteractive
nodes.summary: Interactive chat loop: maintains conversation history, accepts user input via Scanner, encodes dialog with ChatFormat, runs inference, prints streamed response, stops on stop tokens.

nodes.name: runInstructOnce
nodes.summary: Single-shot instruction mode: encodes system prompt + user prompt via ChatFormat, runs inference, prints and returns the response string.

nodes.name: process
nodes.summary: subgraph4j node entry point. Parses options from input pin, loads model (via AOT or ModelLoader), selects sampler, runs interactive or single-shot mode, writes result to output pin.

nodes.name: ModelLoader.java
nodes.summary: Model loading pipeline: parses GGUF metadata, creates Configuration, loads quantized weights from tensor entries, builds Tokenizer with BPE merges

nodes.name: ModelLoader
nodes.summary: Static model loading utilities. loadModel() reads GGUF metadata, creates Llama.Configuration, loads tensor entries, calls loadWeights() to populate Llama.Weights, and creates Tokenizer with BPE merge rules. loadQuantized() dispatches to the correct tensor type (Q8_0, Q4_0, BF16, F16, F32).

nodes.name: loadModel
nodes.summary: Full model loading pipeline: opens GGUF file, reads metadata, loads vocabulary, creates Tokenizer (BPE + special tokens), builds Configuration from metadata, loads tensor entries, calls loadWeights(), returns new Llama instance.

nodes.name: loadWeights
nodes.summary: Populates Llama.Weights from tensor entries: loads each weight matrix (token_embedding_table, rms_att_weight, wq/wk/wv/wo, rms_ffn_weight, w1/w2/w3, rms_final_weight, freq_cis_real/imag, wcls) via loadQuantized/loadArrayOfQuantized/loadArrayOfFloatBuffer. Precomputes RoPE frequencies.

nodes.name: createTokenizer
nodes.summary: Creates a Tokenizer from GGUF metadata and vocabulary. Reads BPE merge rules, builds special tokens map from model metadata, constructs token list with special tokens appended.

nodes.name: Pair.java
nodes.summary: Generic immutable pair/tuple record used throughout the codebase for key-value and paired return values

nodes.name: Parallel.java
nodes.summary: Utility class for CPU-parallel for-each loops using Java parallel streams over int and long ranges

nodes.name: Parallel
nodes.summary: Static utility for CPU-parallel iteration. parallelFor() uses IntStream.range().parallel().forEach() and parallelForLong() uses LongStream.range(). Used by FloatTensor.matmul() and Llama.forward() for batched operations.

nodes.name: RoPE.java
nodes.summary: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) frequency precomputation for Llama models

nodes.name: RoPE
nodes.summary: RoPE frequency precomputation. precomputeFreqsCis() computes cos/sin frequencies for each position and head dimension using theta-based exponential decay, with support for rope scaling and context extension.

nodes.name: precomputeFreqsCis
nodes.summary: Precomputes RoPE cosine/sine frequencies for all positions up to contextLength. Supports optional rope scaling (linear, freq_factor) and extended context via oldContextLength. Returns a Pair of real and imag FloatBuffers.

nodes.name: Timer.java
nodes.summary: AutoCloseable timer utility for measuring and logging elapsed time of operations

nodes.name: Timer
nodes.summary: AutoCloseable timer. log() creates a Timer and prints the elapsed time on close(). Used for benchmarking model loading and inference steps.

nodes.name: Tokenizer.java
nodes.summary: BPE tokenizer for GPT-2 style encoding/decoding. Encodes text to token IDs via byte-pair encoding merges and decodes token IDs back to text. Handles special tokens and provides byte-to-unicode mapping.

nodes.name: ToppSampler.java
nodes.summary: Top-p (nucleus) sampling implementation. Uses a heap-based approach to select tokens from the smallest set whose cumulative probability exceeds the threshold, with cutoff optimization.

nodes.name: Vocabulary.java
nodes.summary: Java record holding token strings and scores with bidirectional lookup. Provides token-by-index and index-by-token resolution for the vocabulary.

nodes.name: module-info.java
nodes.summary: Java module declaration for com.llama4j, declaring dependencies on incubator vector, java.desktop, logging, and native libraries.

nodes.name: package.bluej
nodes.summary: BlueJ IDE project configuration file with editor layout, window positions, and package target settings.

nodes.name: G2PTokenizerTest.java
nodes.summary: JUnit test for a grapheme-to-phoneme tokenizer. Tests encoding input words to token IDs and decoding model output IDs back to phonemes using a G2P vocabulary.

nodes.name: JUnitTest.java
nodes.summary: Simple JUnit test that instantiates the Llama3 model to verify basic initialization.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Core BPE tokenizer class with 18 methods implementing GPT-2 compatible encode/decode, special token handling, byte-to-unicode mapping, and merge-based tokenization.

nodes.name: Tokenizer
nodes.summary: Constructor that initializes the compiled regex pattern, special tokens map, and merges map from the vocabulary and merge pairs.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Encodes text to token IDs with special token handling. Splits text on special token boundaries and encodes each segment separately.

nodes.name: encodeOrdinary
nodes.summary: Encodes text ignoring special tokens by splitting into regex-defined chunks and encoding each chunk via BPE.

nodes.name: encodeChunk
nodes.summary: Encodes a single text chunk via BPE by converting bytes to token IDs, then repeatedly merging the pair with the lowest merge index.

nodes.name: merge
nodes.summary: Merges adjacent token pairs in the ID list according to the BPE merge map, replacing matched pairs with the merged index.

nodes.name: bytesToUnicode
nodes.summary: Builds a lookup table mapping UTF-8 bytes to unicode code points, avoiding control characters that the BPE code cannot handle.

nodes.name: replaceControlCharacters
nodes.summary: Replaces control characters in a code point array with escaped unicode representations, preserving newlines.

nodes.name: ToppSampler
nodes.summary: Implements the Sampler interface using top-p nucleus sampling with a heap-based partial sort for efficiency.

nodes.name: siftDown
nodes.summary: Heap sift-down operation used to maintain the max-heap property during partial sorting of candidate tokens.

nodes.name: sampleToken
nodes.summary: Performs top-p sampling: crops low-probability tokens, builds a max-heap, truncates to cumulative probability threshold, and samples from the remaining candidates.

nodes.name: Vocabulary
nodes.summary: Java record storing token strings and scores with bidirectional token-to-index and index-to-token lookup.

nodes.name: G2PTokenizerTest
nodes.summary: JUnit test class for G2P tokenizer with methods to load vocabulary, encode graphemes, decode phonemes, and run the full test pipeline.

nodes.name: loadVocab
nodes.summary: Loads a G2P vocabulary file into token-to-ID and ID-to-token lookup maps, one token per line.

nodes.name: encode
nodes.summary: Encodes input text to token IDs with optional start/end tokens, handling unknown characters via UNK token.

nodes.name: decode
nodes.summary: Decodes token IDs to phoneme strings, filtering out special tokens like UNK, START, END, and PAD.

nodes.name: test
nodes.summary: JUnit test method that encodes an input word and decodes simulated model output to verify the tokenizer pipeline.

tour.title: Project Overview & Build System
tour.description: Begin with the README to understand the project's purpose — a Java-based Llama model inference engine. The Ant build script and NetBeans project configuration define how the project is compiled, tested, and packaged, with dependencies on AIBase, opencv, and RXTXcomm.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: Llama3.java is the CLI application that orchestrates the full inference pipeline: it loads the model via ModelLoader, initializes the tokenizer, runs the generation loop, and handles chat interaction. ChatFormat provides the Llama 3 chat template for system/user/assistant message formatting.

tour.title: Model File Parsing & Weight Loading
tour.description: GGUF.java parses the GGUF model file format, extracting metadata and tensor entries. ModelLoader reads these parsed tensors, creates the appropriate quantized tensor objects, and initializes the model state. AOT.java provides ahead-of-time preloading to reduce inference latency.

tour.title: Core Inference Engine
tour.description: Llama.java is the heart of the model — it implements the forward pass through transformer layers, manages the KV-cache for autoregressive generation, and orchestrates attention computations. RoPE.java provides Rotary Position Embeddings to encode token positions, while Parallel.java distributes tensor operations across CPU threads.

tour.title: Tensor Hierarchy & Matrix Operations
tour.description: All neural network computations are built on the FloatTensor abstract base class, which defines matrix arithmetic, reshaping, and indexing primitives. ArrayFloatTensor provides the default dense implementation, while BF16FloatTensor and F16FloatTensor offer memory-efficient half-precision storage for larger models.

tour.title: Model Quantization
tour.description: To fit large language models into memory, the project supports quantized tensor types. Q4_0FloatTensor uses 4-bit quantization with block scaling for maximum compression, while Q8_0FloatTensor provides 8-bit quantization as a balance between size and precision. GGMLType enumerates all supported formats with metadata.

tour.title: Tokenization & Token Sampling
tour.description: Tokenizer.java implements BPE tokenization to convert text to token IDs and back. Vocabulary.java maps between IDs and string tokens. Once the model produces logits, Sampler.java and its implementations — CategoricalSampler (direct probability sampling) and ToppSampler (nucleus sampling with a binary heap) — select the next token.

tour.title: Tests & Supporting Utilities
tour.description: JUnit tests validate the tokenizer (G2PTokenizerTest) and exercise the full inference pipeline (JUnitTest). Supporting utility classes like Pair (generic tuple), Timer (performance profiling), and the module-info.java descriptor round out the project structure.
